method.pass_rate: task mean (each task's mean over its scored attempts, then the mean over tasks), task bootstrap 95% interval
method.paired: per task, arm mean minus reference mean over scored attempts, tasks scored in both; clusteredPairedDelta task bootstrap 95% interval and two-sided task-level sign-flip p; Holm within model over the selected minus arms, the diet and full vs none (no paired task counts as p = 1)
method.tokens: tokens per scored trial; total = input + output (input holds cached); paired ratio arm over reference = sum of per-task mean total tokens, paired task bootstrap
method.cost: recorded usd of every trial of the arm (excluded ones included) over scored passes, task bootstrap
method.pooled: frontier models that passed headroom; mean of all per-task differences, bootstrap resampling tasks within each model; within-10 when the 90% lower bound is above -0.1
method.verdicts: KEEP when the pooled 95% interval is wholly below 0; else CUT-CANDIDATE when within-10 and the pooled token ratio is at or below 1; else FIX-METHOD with the MDD (half the pooled 95% interval width)
